objective: Blocker B-032 (web half): since 2026-10-21 the blocking web-dependency-security check fails on every run (work branch head f5904860, run 40268381775; main's scheduled-web-audit daily since run 39599073207). `npm audit --audit-level=low` reports 5 vulnerabilities (2 moderate, 2 high, 1 critical): next 15.5.27 (exact pin; GHSA-2464-fhr4-w9xw critical, GHSA-p3m5-59mp-jv5r high; first patched 15.5.28), vitest 4.1.11 (exact pin) through @vitest/mocker 4.1.11 (GHSA-qxg6-89mg-rqv8, GHSA-xp26-3454-mjgp, medium; first patched 4.1.12), vite 7.3.6 (transitive dev dependency of vitest, @vitest/mocker and @vitejs/plugin-react; vite advisories GHSA-9jrq-w75r-8gcw, GHSA-rq7h-c2jc-7f22 and the bundled launch-editor advisories GHSA-698v-4r3x-3vcv, GHSA-r825-w8mm-5pxw, GHSA-587h-7wmj-h5pm; first patched 7.3.7 on the 7.x line) and zod 4.6.5 (transitive dev dependency of eslint-plugin-react-hooks and zod-validation-error; GHSA-mrhx-c7xc-m3w5 high; first patched 4.6.6). Repair it under the NORMAL dependency policy with no exception of any kind: move the exact pins next -> 15.5.28 and vitest -> 4.1.12, add exact overrides "vite": "7.3.7" and "zod": "4.6.6" beside the existing overrides (the oldest advisory-free fix version of each; the lock generator never upgrades a satisfied transitive on its own), and regenerate the lock through .github/workflows/generate-lockfile.yml (never by hand, never on a local machine). Registry facts read by the orchestrator on 2026-10-27 about 04:10 UTC (registry.npmjs.org): next 15.5.28 2026-10-14T17:36:08.917Z; vitest 4.1.12 2026-10-15T14:51:24.991Z; @vitest/mocker 4.1.12 2026-10-15T14:40:12.730Z; vite 7.3.7 2026-10-06T05:11:19.017Z; zod 4.6.6 2026-10-11T16:18:23.878Z; each older than 604800 s. The producer re-reads every fact at the registry and the advisory database on the day. The machine gates decide: the workflow's npm audit must report zero findings at every severity and its committed-lock age gate must pass on every package; if either fails, STOP and report - no waiver, no exclusion, no change to .npmrc or to the gate.
business_reason: CLAUDE.md principle 15 and directive D-009: no dependency may carry an unresolved advisory affecting the installed version; audits fail closed (D-009-R002); the web lock is regenerated through the CI workflow and validated there (D-009-R017). Blocker B-032: while the advisories stand every run is red, so no wave-29 task can be gated or accepted and the owner's next report proof (PDF #6, D-094 R317) cannot be signed off on a green run. next is the production website framework and the critical advisory is a remote-code-execution class. Ordinary work under the standing policy (ADR-006 Tier A; the dependency change itself is security-reviewed, gate G5); every fix version already meets the 7-day rule, so no owner exception is needed or sought. Contracted on the wave-29 branch because one ledger-touching branch is open at a time; it touches none of the wave's other files.
